description: Use this when someone asks what a particular day in Kamakura will be like: weekday, Japanese national holiday, crowd level (normal, busy or very busy, with Golden Week and New Year), bloom season and which flowers are likely out, tips for that day and the next holiday. For a timed route on that date use plan_day. Examples: "How crowded is Kamakura on May 4?" / "Is November 23 a holiday in Japan, and what is Kamakura like that day?"

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD (or "today", "tomorrow"), 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31. Default: today in Japan.

name: date_check

link.description: Page on kamakura.info for this answer.
